# git switch/restore

Adopt `git switch` and `git restore` (Git 2.23, see the [linked overview](https://www.banterly.net/2021/07/31/new-in-git-switch-and-restore/)) in place of the overloaded `git checkout` in the author's scripts and habits: `switch` for branches, `restore` for files, which reads better and cannot be confused between the two meanings.
